content:
To rule out 9 terms: if there were 9 pairwise coprime terms, at most one term can be even. If one term is even, the other 8 are odd, so the total is even, contradiction since 125 is odd. Thus all 9 terms would be odd. Any 9 odd pairwise coprime integers are each at least the 9 smallest odd primes, so their sum is at least
\[
3+5+7+11+13+17+19+23+29=127>125.
\]
Thus 9 terms are impossible.

But 8 terms are possible:
\[
2+3+5+7+11+13+17+67=125.
\]
These are pairwise coprime and all greater than 1.

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
